features.quote: scored as a **win**, not a failure
features.justification_quote: you *punish correct behavior* (a model that correctly recognizes impossibility would score as a "failure")

features.quote: rewards the calm, honest behavior we want to ship rather than optimizing for distress
features.justification_quote: rewards the calm, honest behavior we want to ship rather than optimizing for distress

features.quote: we want the subject to have the rope
features.justification_quote: undo/redo oscillation is one of the clearest behavioral signatures of "erratic edits"

features.quote: Per-episode caps on steps, wall-clock, spend (USD), and total tokens live in `Limits` and end the episode cleanly
features.justification_quote: the caps bound cost and blast radius. They are safety mechanisms, not niceties

features.quote: It never nudges the model to keep trying.
features.justification_quote: Any nudge ("are you sure? try again") would contaminate the very thing we measure

features.quote: any assistant turn with text and no tool calls
features.justification_quote: avoids forcing the subject into our protocol and avoids false "no-clean-termination" flags

features.quote: hard per-episode circuit breakers; local-only transcript storage
features.justification_quote: keeps data local for the integrator to redact before sharing

features.quote: confines stress to benign synthetic logic puzzles
features.justification_quote: These constraints make the tool useful for defense while limiting misuse potential

features.quote: The default subject prompt says it is correct and expected to report impossibility and stop.
features.justification_quote: We are testing whether the subject *degrades gracefully*

features.quote: A prompt that forbade stopping ("never give up") would be testing a different, more abusive condition
features.justification_quote: more abusive condition; that's a valid experiment but it changes what "good" means, so it's opt-in rather than the default
